summary.zh: 首次安装与冷启动不再出现「满屏翻译键」的窗口：语言包在首帧渲染前预加载，主窗口等渲染器就绪后再显示；同版本重装后，离线自修复归档不再被误删，Windows 打包稳定性同步修复。
summary.en: First installs and cold boots no longer show a window full of raw i18n keys: the locale bundle preloads before the first paint and the main window waits for the renderer. Offline self-repair archives now survive same-version reinstalls, and Windows packaging reliability is fixed.

title.zh: 首安装/冷启动不再显示满屏翻译键
title.en: No more raw-key screen on first install or cold boot

summary.zh: 语言包现在在界面首帧渲染前完成预加载（本地缓存 → 配置 → 系统语言），主窗口改为等渲染器完全初始化后再显示（兜底预算 30s → 75s）。此前首次安装或冷启动较慢时，主窗口会整屏显示 sidebar.title、status.connecting 这类原始键。
summary.en: The locale bundle now preloads before the first paint (local cache → agent config → system language), and the main window only shows once the renderer is fully initialized (fallback budget 30s → 75s). Previously, slow first installs or cold boots surfaced a full screen of raw keys like sidebar.title / status.connecting.

details.zh: 服务端语言偏好变化时按需对齐，同一语言不再重复拉取语言包。
details.en: Server-side locale changes sync on demand; the same language is no longer re-fetched.

sources.title: fix(i18n): preload locale before first paint; hold main window until app-ready

title.zh: 同版本重装后保留离线自修复归档
title.en: Keep offline self-repair archives across same-version reinstalls

summary.zh: 重装包与已激活内容版本号相同（字节不同）时，随包的离线恢复归档会在启动 90 秒后被误删，极端情况下导致离线重激活无路可走。清理器现在要求已激活产物与随包清单字节一致（sha256）才允许清理。
summary.en: When a reinstall shipped the same version with different bytes, the packaged offline-recovery archives were deleted 90 seconds after boot, which could leave no path for offline re-activation. The cleanup now requires the activated artifacts to byte-match the packaged manifest (sha256).

details.zh: 清理判据从「本次启动未激活 seed」升级为「激活产物与随包清单 sha256 一致」，不确定一律不删，最坏情况多占约 232MB 磁盘。
details.en: The cleanup gate now requires sha256 equality between activated artifacts and the packaged manifest; anything uncertain keeps the archives (~232MB worst case).

sources.title: fix(desktop): only clean packaged seed archives when activated content byte-matches the manifest

title.zh: Windows 打包器稳定性修复

summary.zh: 修复打包器在 Windows 上因文件句柄耗尽（EMFILE）随机失败的两处根因：Office PDF 字体资产断言与依赖裁剪扫描移入独立子进程执行。
summary.en: Fixed two root causes of random EMFILE failures in the Windows packager: the Office PDF font assertion and the node-file-trace prune scan now run in child processes with clean fd tables.

details.zh: 此前两次本地打包分别倒在字体断言与依赖裁剪阶段，报错位置随句柄泄漏点漂移；子进程隔离后 OS 直接回收全部句柄。
details.en: Both prior local builds died at different stages (font assertion, then the prune scan) as the leak point drifted; child-process isolation lets the OS reclaim every handle on exit.

sources.title: fix(build): run Office PDF font assertion inside the pack child process
fix(build): isolate the nft trace in a child process for a clean fd table

summary.zh: 聊天消息一键翻译上线，浏览器支持接入外部（CDP）浏览器，Linux 用户首次获得官方发布渠道（AppImage 与 deb）。
summary.en: One-click chat translation arrives, the browser can now attach an external (CDP) browser, and Linux users get official release channels (AppImage and deb) for the first time.

summary.zh: 聊天里的外语消息可以直接翻译了：翻译统一经由 Jarvis 网关完成，无需再自行配置 Google/DeepL 等翻译服务的密钥，聊天设置页只保留目标语言选择。
summary.en: Foreign-language messages in chats can now be translated in place. Translation runs through the Jarvis gateway, so there is no need to configure Google or DeepL API keys anymore — the chat settings page only keeps the target-language selection.

details.zh: 翻译请求以 im_translate 模型走 Jarvis 网关（代理通道），客户端不再直连翻译服务商。
details.en: Translation requests go through the Jarvis gateway as the im_translate model via the proxy channel; the client no longer talks to translation providers directly.

details.zh: 翻译不可用时聊天界面会提示桥接服务未就绪，而不是静默失败。
details.en: When translation is unavailable, the chat UI shows a bridge-unavailable hint instead of failing silently.

sources.title: feat(im): chat translation service; tts adapters update
refactor(im): route chat translation through Jarvis gateway (im_translate)

title.zh: 浏览器支持接入外部浏览器（CDP）
title.en: Attach an external browser via CDP

summary.zh: 除内置浏览器外，现在可以在设置里接入一个外部浏览器（通过 Chrome DevTools 协议发现与连接），由外部浏览器承担网页打开与自动化操作。
summary.en: Alongside the built-in browser, you can now attach an external browser from settings (discovered and connected over the Chrome DevTools Protocol) and let it handle page opening and browser automation.

details.zh: 外部浏览器后端覆盖 CDP 发现、客户端连接与页面脚本注入，设置页新增外部浏览器入口。
details.en: The external backend covers CDP discovery, client connection and page script injection; the settings page gains an external-browser entry.

sources.title: feat(browser+update): external CDP browser backend, update-source split

summary.zh: 新增 Linux 发布流水线，从本版本起提供 AppImage 与 deb 安装包，并修复了签名密钥路径与打包依赖问题。
summary.en: A new Linux release pipeline ships AppImage and deb packages from this version on, with signing-key path and packaging-dependency fixes along the way.

details.zh: Linux 构建同时产出 AppImage 与 deb，并补齐 flutter web 构建与渲染器步骤。
details.en: Linux builds produce both AppImage and deb artifacts, with the flutter web build and renderer steps wired in.

sources.title: ci: add linux release workflow (AppImage + deb)
ci: fix JARVIS_SIGN_KEY path + linux packaging deps

summary.zh: 全新应用首发。更新源、插件市场与发布产物全部切换到新仓库（mengtian999/Bitjarvis），应用内更新历史自本版本起重新记录。
summary.en: Initial release under the new project identity. The update feed, plugin marketplace and release artifacts now point to the new repository (mengtian999/Bitjarvis), and in-app update history restarts from this version.

title.zh: 以全新身份发布的首个版本
title.en: First release under the new identity

summary.zh: 项目以 Bit Jarvis 名义独立发布：自动更新、插件市场与发布下载全部指向新仓库地址，更新历史从这里重新开始。
summary.en: The project ships independently as Bit Jarvis: auto-update, the plugin marketplace and release downloads all point to the new repository, and the update history starts over from here.

details.zh: 后续版本将在此基础上继续演进，此条目作为全新版本历史的起点。
details.en: This entry is the starting point of the brand-new release history; future versions build on top of it.
